title: FallTech 7410 Temporary Reusable Roofing Anchor
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B00C0GQVXC is FallTech model 7410, the hinged reusable wood roof anchor with nails (UPC 848013070647).

comparisons.notes: MPN 7410 and UPC 848013070647 match. Available to order; expected to ship in seven days, so physical stock is unconfirmed.
SKU FP-7410; includes nails. Product page reports four units in stock.

writeup: Woot has a new FallTech 7410 reusable hinged roofing anchor with nails for $14.68. Jendco Safety Supply lists the matching MPN 7410 and UPC 848013070647 anchor at $36.80, available to order with an expected ship time of about seven days. Becker Fire & Rescue has the same FP-7410 unit in stock, four available, at $46. That is about 60 percent below Jendco and saves roughly $22. Woot showed 10+ left with a limit of ten per customer.
